title: Thanking Joe Jordan; the William Grant Still concert
summary: Thomas thanks Joe Jordan for helping him get his union card and mentions Jordan conducting William Grant Still's work.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Now you go back to Henderson when you got your card.

I met Joe Jordan and I thanked him. I had a little trouble getting the card and I thanked him for that. Joe Jordan is a tremendous person. I think he died out in Oregon around six months ago. And he's around 89 years old. We did a ... a fellow you might remember by the name of William Grant Still (Steele). We did a ...
Wrote me a letter not long ago.
No kidding. Him I didn't know. I met him in later years but Joe Jordan conducted the band out there and added to my respect of Joe Jordan.
Oh, yeah. So, back to Henderson.
